question: Which of the following was the capital of Mahajanapada Gandhara in 6th century BC?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3.**__ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct answer is **Taxila.**
 
• The capital of Gandhara was **Taxila.**
 
• Gandhara was one of the** 16 Mahajanpadas**, its present location is in** Afganistan **and some parts of it lie in **Pakistan**. We find the mention of **Gandhara in Anguttara Nikaya (a Buddhist source).**
 
• **List of Mahajanapadas and their Capitals**:**​**​
 
 
• Anga - Champa.
 
• Magadha - Girivraja or Rajagriha
 
• kasi - kasi
 
• vatsa - Kausambi
 
• Kosala - Shravasti
 
• Surasena - Mathura
 
• Panchala - Ahichchatra and Kampilya
 
• Kuru - Indraprastha
 
• Matsya - Viratanagara
 
• Chedi - Sothivati
 
• Avanti - Ujjaini/Mahismati
 
• Gandhara - Taxila
 
• Kamboja - Poonch
 
• Asmaka - Potali or Podana
 
• Vajji - Vaishali
 
• Malla - Kushinara. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Mahajanapada:
 
 
• Period: 6th - 4th Century BC,
 
• It is a group of 16 City States that emerged during the 6th century BC.
 
• Most of them were Monarchies but Some were Republics.
